text: This is a proposed synthetic curriculum for TYM's narrative temporal and segment-label tasks. It builds on documented temporal annotation gaps: nominalized events and long-distance links in TIMELINE, and dense event-pair annotation in NarrativeTime. Sources: https://aclanthology.org/2023.emnlp-main.1016/ and https://aclanthology.org/2024.lrec-main.1054/. All generated labels remain candidates until checked against the annotation guideline.

text: Recommended controls are hypotheses and protocol design, not implemented data generation. Recent synthetic-data studies report distribution-shift and diversity risks. For example, Kambhatla et al. find that fine-grained persona detail adds little lexical-diversity gain beyond a length cutoff in their setting; Geng et al. show pseudo-label alignment and distribution shift concerns for synthetic QE. Sources: https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-emnlp.1146/ and https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.373/. These results motivate measurement and human auditing, not direct transfer of their findings to TYM.

text: Corpus roles are intentionally separate. NarrativeTime provides dense timeline annotations over TimeBank-Dense news and reports two independent expert annotations; its guidelines, tools, and annotations are available under MIT according to the paper. TIMELINE targets exhaustive news relations, including long-distance and nominalized events. CaTeRS annotates 320 five-sentence ROCStories with causal and temporal relations, useful as a short-story diagnostic but not as TYM labels. MEANTIME contains 120 English news articles and translations in Spanish, Italian, and Dutch; its non-English annotations were partly projected from English and should not be treated as independent target-language gold without audit. The user's two custom TYM XMLs are one parallel story, not two independent evaluation documents. Ro-TimeBank is a different ISO-TimeML event/time corpus. Confirm source text, annotation, and model derivative rights before using or releasing any corpus. Sources: https://aclanthology.org/2024.lrec-main.1054/ ; https://aclanthology.org/2023.emnlp-main.1016/ ; https://aclanthology.org/W16-1007/ ; https://aclanthology.org/L16-1699/ ; https://aclanthology.org/L12-1451/.

text: Counts were computed from the user's two supplied TYM XML files with a secure importer. 375 Romanian TS and 376 English TS segments have 375 shared span intervals. Both files contain 382 TREL tags; the importer skips one Romanian TREL with an unresolved endpoint and maps a source spelling variant SIMMULTANEOUS to SIMULTANEOUS. The parser generated 1,515 private training rows across segment_type and temporal_relation for both languages. No test metrics were generated because both editions are one story. The Ro-TimeBank archive contains 183 Romanian texts and 181 EN-RO aligned pairs, but it uses ISO-TimeML event, time, signal, and link annotations. The user-provided 2011 thesis and Forăscu & Tufiș (2012) report a 99.18% annotation transfer rate after corrections; do not quote this as classifier accuracy. NAS-BERT training was attempted and failed checkpoint loading (expected 60 state_dict entries, found 142), matching the open ML.NET issue https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/7350; the unsupported option was removed. Sources: https://aclanthology.org/L12-1451/ ; user-supplied Forăscu (2011) thesis PDF.

text: Conference-specific adaptation is based on the official 2027 calls checked on 1 October 2026. EACL's theme is The Human in Language; a new EACL main ARR submission is no longer possible because its 3 August deadline passed, so this fit applies only to already reviewed ARR work or an eligible separate route. COLING's theme is NLP for Linguistics and explicitly highlights linguistic diversity and under-researched languages. NAACL covers low-resource NLP, generalization, human-centric NLP, resources, evaluation, and semantics; its agentic-communication theme says multiple agents alone are insufficient. ACL's theme is Homogenization and knowledge collapse in LLMs, requiring direct diversity or homogenization analysis for a thematic claim. EMNLP 2027 CFP/theme is not yet published; the empirical-methods framing is provisional. Sources: https://2027.eacl.org/calls/papers/ ; https://2027.coling-iccl.org/calls/main_conference_papers/ ; https://2027.naacl.org/calls/main_conference_papers/ ; https://2027.aclweb.org/calls/main/.

text: These are proposed decision gates. Do not commit private corpus text to the public repository unless its rights permit it. Synthetic examples can hide template leakage and pseudo-label error; generator holdout and independent human gold address these risks. Clustering introduces its own risk: lexical groups can look coherent without representing the target semantic classes.
